book.title: Me After You
book.author: Nishant Batra
book.description:
He has spent more than a decade photographing strangers in Lisbon because the camera lets him keep the world at the length of an arm.

He knows the exact moment to click: when the light is generous, when the subject has forgotten to guard their face, when the story they are telling themselves looks almost true.

He has never turned the lens around.

He does not do portraits. He does not do permanence. He has learned to be necessary to no one, to leave before the leaving is noticed, to make his absence feel like a gift rather than a wound.

Then she sees him truly.

Not the performance. Not the charm he can switch on and off. Something else. Something he did not know was still there.

And for the first time in years, the city starts to feel less like an escape and more like a place he might belong.

He is not sure which frightens him more: that she might leave, or that he might not be capable of her.
